key_difference: (D) implements clearLocalData() as an unguarded inline d.set(nullptr), leaving the QThreadData::currentThreadData() shutdown guard at the call site in qcollator.cpp. (B) moves that guard into a new exported QThreadStorageData::clear(), so the public API itself is safe during shutdown. (D) even documents clearLocalData() as unsafe at shutdown, so other callers would re-create thread data with nothing left to destroy it.
